description: Check against rules and risks: the layout lint of a room or box, the lint rule set, whether things are replaceable, the player's ignition risk. Read only.

options.box: Two corners; at most 4000 2 m cells.
options.id: layout: Narrows: only findings on these things (up to 256); room or box is still needed. rules: explain: a thing, network or room id. replaceable: Things to check (1 to 1024); a list answers one row per id, {results: [{index, ok, reference_id, payload | error}], count, success_count, error_count}, payload the one-id reply; a bad id is a row with error. ignition: A tank, canister or pipe network: its contents' autoignition margin, a list one row each; left out, the player's carried items.

layout.summary: lint a room or a box against the layout rules: replaceability, doors, ports, floating runs, overlaps and more

box.description: Two corners; at most 4000 2 m cells.

id.description: Narrows: only findings on these things (up to 256); room or box is still needed.

since.description: Only findings on this id and higher ids (what was made after it).

limit.x-script: The first n in order (findings returned); left out, every one.

rules.summary: the lint rule set: list, validate a file, fields, functions, run examples, explain a finding

action.description: list the rules, validate a rule file, list fields or functions, test examples, or explain a finding.

full.description: list: every rule's file and expressions.
